input: Existing R4 H01 seed12 A0 wind_trace.csv, all 1200 observations through 240 s; existing House01 navigation occupancy geometry only
purpose: Construct chronological full-field conditional GMRF means from actually available local wind, then falsify one-step local predictions before using these means as source-to-path transport inputs.
solver: Installed GMRF core, synchronous one Picard iteration after each new wind observation, no wall-clock timer
parameter_origin: Current ROS node defaults and explicit AddWindObservation service variances; no fit to this trace
forecast: Previous completed spatial mean queried at current observed pose before assimilating current wind; first scored forecast at 0.4 s
comparators: Last local vector persistence queried irrespective of pose; stratify same printed pose versus changed printed pose
interpretation: This tests a conditional mean forecaster on spent local wind, not spatial field truth, joint uncertainty calibration, gas prediction, source recovery, novelty, or closed-loop benefit. No success gate is inferred from a lower wind RMSE.
downstream: If the mean forecast is inadequate, do not call its source propagation trustworthy. Do not tune this diagnostic on H01 or silently re-label the current field as a calibrated wind posterior. Source-to-path response and unknown prehistory remain required.
